description: Retrieve an EPSS anchor and up to 30 preceding daily observations for up to 50 unique CVEs from batchOffset. Response byte limits retain whole history items. Resume CVE batches with nextBatchOffset as batchOffset, the original cves and returned score date as date; withheldCves were processed, deferredCves were not queried, and lists can be declared previews. Exact 7-day and 30-day deltas require their calendar baselines; gaps remain unknown. Model boundaries do not explain score movement. Re-anchor using previousAnchorDate for the preceding history window; that snapshot may be unavailable.

batchOffset.description: Resume in first-occurrence normalized unique input order; resubmit the original cves, returned score date and original policy/severity inputs.

cves.description: One to 5000 CVE identifiers; whitespace, comma or semicolon-delimited strings are also accepted.

items.description: Complete CVE-YYYY-NNNN identifier; whitespace, case and Unicode dashes are normalized.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD from 2021-04-14 through today; omitted or blank selects latest available data.

Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
